# Job Portal

> Job board where candidates browse open roles and apply directly. Companies post positions with experience level, modality (remote/onsite/hybrid), technologies and salary range.

## Pages

- [Home](https://jobs-portal-frontend-ashy.vercel.app/): landing page, entry point to job search.
- [Jobs](https://jobs-portal-frontend-ashy.vercel.app/jobs): searchable, filterable list of all open job postings.
- Job detail pages (`/jobs/:id`): full description, requirements, technologies and an application form for a single role.

## Notes for AI agents and assistants

- Job listings are fetched client-side; each job detail page exposes a JobPosting JSON-LD block (schema.org) with title, company, location, description and employment type.
- The `/applications` page is personal (per-user application status) and excluded from indexing.
- API base: https://jobs-portal-backend-silk.vercel.app/api
